items.prompt: Which comparison is meaningful before interpreting two runtimes?

options.text: Compare any fast routine with any slow routine regardless of output
options.why: Different tasks do not establish algorithm performance for the same contract.

options.text: Verify both compute the same required output on the tested cases
options.why: Correctness/contract checks come before timing claims.

options.text: Delete input validation from just one routine without disclosure
Hide preprocessing for one side even when every request pays it
options.why: That misstates the relevant execution boundary.

items.explanation: An unfairly different contract or execution boundary can make timing numbers irrelevant to the real choice.
